name: csharp.create_sheets_from_views
description: Bulk-create one new sheet per supplied view, place that view on the sheet, and auto-number the sheets with a prefix and starting number. The whole batch is one Transaction (one undo step). Use after csharp.list_views, or whenever the user wants to generate a sheet set ('make sheets for all my elevations', 'one sheet per detail view', etc.).

view_ids.description: Element IDs of views to create sheets for. Get these from csharp.list_views.
